New York Times :

 How CFTC Chairman Michael Selig reversed long-standing policy to authorize perpetual crypto and stock trades on Kalshi and others, despite SEC staff concerns   —  After a federal regulator allowed wagering on stocks and cryptocurrencies, two powerful trading clearinghouses filed lawsuits saying traders would not be properly protected.
